parts.name: Screen Side
parts.Basic_description: This is the screen side of the laptop, primarily made of glass and plastic framing. It displays visual output to the user.
parts.Functional_description: The screen side functions as the display interface, showing images, videos, and text. It is connected to the base via a hinge mechanism.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate around the hinge axis to open or close the laptop.

parts.name: Base Side
parts.Basic_description: This is the base side of the laptop, made of aluminum housing the keyboard, touchpad, and internal components.
parts.Functional_description: The base side supports the keyboard and touchpad for user input and contains the main hardware components such as the motherboard and battery.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use but serves as the main support structure for the laptop.

parts.name: Decoration (Other)
parts.Basic_description: This part includes decorative or branding elements on the laptop, typically made of plastic or coated material.
parts.Functional_description: It serves aesthetic and branding purposes, such as logos or light strips, without affecting the laptop’s core functionality.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move relative to other parts.
